text: 叙利亚中央银行11日说，该行签发近14年来的首份信用证，为叙利亚石油公司与沙特阿美石油公司达成的石油产品供应协议提供便利。叙利亚央行说，这笔交易在一家美国主要银行的协调下完成。但叙方没有说明具体是哪家美国银行。信用证是银行根据开证申请人要求向受益人开立的有条件付款承诺，是国际贸易中最常用的结算方式之一。据悉，这笔交易标志着叙利亚在摘掉所谓“支持恐怖主义的国家”帽子和摆脱西方制裁后正重新接入国际金融体系。（央视新闻）
text_en: Syria's central bank said on the 11th that it had issued its first letter of credit in nearly 14 years, facilitating an oil product supply agreement between the Syrian Petroleum Company and Saudi Aramco. The Syrian central bank said the transaction was completed with coordination from a major US bank, but did not specify which US bank. A letter of credit is a conditional payment commitment issued by a bank at the request of the applicant in favor of the beneficiary, and is one of the most commonly used settlement methods in international trade. It is reported that this transaction marks Syria's re-entry into the international financial system after shedding the so-called "state sponsor of terrorism" label and emerging from Western sanctions. (CCTV News)
